reason: Under the alternative the expected OS deaths of E1 reach the first target (150) at month 20.84, just after the end of accrual at month 20, so that the package counts all 400 patients as enrolled at the first look. The simulated time of the 150th death varies around it (mean 20.82) and falls before month 20 in a part of the trials, so that the simulated mean number of enrolled patients is 398.7 at the first look and 399.73 at the stop. The package ignores the variability of the analysis times (ms_power(), Details; INFO rows enrolled_at_look and enrolled_indep).

Under the null hypothesis the expected OS deaths of E1 reach the first target (150) at month 19.35, before the end of accrual at month 20 (387.1 patients enrolled). The number of enrolled patients is a concave function of the analysis time (it stops increasing at month 20), so that with the simulated variability of the time of the 150th death (mean 19.33) the mean number enrolled is 385.5 at the first look and 392.79 at the stop, against 393.51 for the package, which ignores the variability of the analysis times (ms_power(), Details; INFO rows enrolled_at_look and enrolled_indep).

The futility bounds by beta spending are computed under the design scenario with the correlations of the statistics from the information (variance = "null") in the package and from the events in gsDesign. At analysis 2 the reference implementation gives 0.94164 with the correlations of the information and 0.94132 with those of the events (printed 0.9413); the row with the variant gsDesign compares the bound of the package with that of gsDesign (abs:5e-4). The conditional powers of the vignette are computed with the futility bounds of gsDesign.
